column1: # Houses the 1910 plan draws built that the Straube reader missed (read as roadway or yard), found 11-17 where the
# plan's printed house numbers (tools/map/numbers.ts, and the Adreßbuch's houses placed on them) fell on no building.
# Each outline is read by eye on a gridded crop of the plan (tools/map/stcrop.ts, 10 m grid, about 0.5 m), moved onto
# the map by the scan's offset field (offsetfield.ts) as the reader's own outlines are, and checked against the
# Adreßbuch 1917 (the house stood: it lists people and firms there). build.sh adds each as a building, less any
# building already there. A lot the plan draws but the directory calls "existiert nicht" (Friedrichstraße 98-99, under
# Rows marked "traced by tools/map/numfill.ts" (11-17, evening) were found among the 149 numbers lying 3-8 m from any
# building: the plan patch each is printed on was flood-filled out to the plan's own lines; 55 of 85 ran on into a street
# or open yard (spot heights, squares, forecourts) and were dropped, and of the 14 closed patches 9 held by eye. Their
# Adreßbuch check waits on the street's transcription, and each row says so.

column3: Friedrichstraße 169-170 and Französische Straße 49a-50, the corner block south of Castan's Panopticum: the plan draws it built (beige, numbered 169, 50, 49A); the Adreßbuch 1917 lists 10 entries (169: Lucas Bols Erven, Likörfabrik; 170: Heudelsohn, Herrenausstattung).
